name: computer-control
title: Computer Control
description: Desktop control plugin for the dsh harness: screen capture, pointer and keyboard injection, accessibility-tree driven semantic actions, with an emergency stop, allow/deny rules, confirmation flow and idle standby.
author: plugin-contributors

tools.name: a11y.activate
tools.summary: Semantically activate an element from the latest snapshot (invoke/toggle/select pattern first; pixel click on its bounding box as fallback).

parameters.name: snapshot_id
parameters.description: The snapshot_id of the most recent a11y.snapshot. Stale ids are rejected.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: auto = pattern then pointer fallback; pattern = patterns only; pointer = skip patterns.

tools.name: a11y.input
tools.summary: Semantically set text on an editable element from the latest snapshot (value pattern first; click-and-type as fallback).

parameters.name: snapshot_id
parameters.description: The snapshot_id of the most recent a11y.snapshot. Stale ids are rejected.

tools.name: a11y.snapshot
tools.summary: Semantic view of the desktop: a hierarchical summary of the accessibility tree with token-cost levels (skeleton/standard/full).

parameters.name: include_rects
parameters.description: Include element bounding rectangles (needed for pointer fallback).

tools.name: batch.execute
tools.summary: Run several actions in one call to cut round trips. Each item is individually gated by the safety policy; the whole batch is confirmation-gated if any item is high-risk.

parameters.name: continue_on_error
parameters.description: Keep running after an item fails.

tools.name: keyboard.combo
tools.summary: Press several keys together as a chord, e.g. ctrl+shift+esc. Chords that include win or ctrl+alt are high-risk and trigger the confirmation flow.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Chord keys as a list ['ctrl','shift','esc'] or a string 'ctrl+shift+esc'.

tools.name: keyboard.press
tools.summary: Press and release a single key (letters, digits, F-keys, arrows, punctuation).

tools.name: keyboard.type
tools.summary: Type text via keyboard events. Newlines become Enter, tabs become Tab.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text to type (UTF-8, up to 10000 characters).

tools.name: pointer.click
tools.summary: Click with a button, optionally after moving to a position. Prefer a11y.activate when the element is visible in the accessibility tree.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Model-space x coordinate; omit to click at the current pointer position.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Model-space y coordinate; omit to click at the current pointer position.

parameters.name: hold_ms
parameters.description: Hold the button down this long before releasing.

tools.name: pointer.drag
tools.summary: Press a button at one position, move to another position, then release.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start position {x, y} in model space.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End position {x, y} in model space.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Number of interpolation steps between the two positions.

parameters.name: hold_ms
parameters.description: Pause at the destination before releasing.

tools.name: pointer.move
tools.summary: Move the mouse pointer to a model-space position without clicking.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Interpolation steps for a smooth move (1 = instant).

tools.name: pointer.scroll
tools.summary: Scroll the wheel at the current pointer position (or after moving to a position).

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Wheel notches, signed: positive = up/right, negative = down/left.

tools.name: screen.capture
tools.summary: Capture the desktop (or a region) as an image. The returned data URL is exactly the model-space canvas the coordinates below refer to.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Model-space region {x, y, width, height} to capture; omit for the whole desktop.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Image encoding: png or jpeg (jpeg costs fewer tokens).

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Relative canvas scale 0.1-1.0; smaller = fewer tokens.

parameters.name: grayscale
parameters.description: Convert to grayscale to save tokens.

tools.name: wait.pause
tools.summary: Wait, letting the UI settle. Use before screenshots after actions that trigger animation.

events.name: session.started
events.summary: A session began and is ready for tools.

events.name: session.stopped
events.summary: A session ended; further tool calls are rejected until a new session starts.

events.name: session.resumed
events.summary: A stopped or standby session returned to ready.

events.name: session.idle
events.summary: No actions for the configured idle timeout; the session entered standby.

events.name: action.finished
events.summary: A tool call finished, with its result envelope.

events.name: batch.finished
events.summary: A batch completed with the aggregated results.

events.name: safety.confirmation_requested
events.summary: A high-risk action is pending human approval; the harness must ask the user.

events.name: safety.confirmation_resolved
events.summary: A pending confirmation was approved or denied.

events.name: safety.confirmation_expired
events.summary: A pending confirmation timed out and was denied.

events.name: safety.panic_triggered
events.summary: The emergency stop engaged (hotkey, protocol request or panic file).
